title: calappa mikaniana
intro: Calappa mikaniana, commonly known as the Calabash Tree, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. The Calabash Tree is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and lower blood pressure. Research suggests that it possesses therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Calappa mikaniana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
